Additionally, the text notes that 'the three-pass approaches typically use high-quality reconstruction kernels for all image generation,' supporting the requirement for high-quality kernels. The context of 'non-axis-aligned rendering' is supported by the discussion of affine transformations and image warping in the context of volume renderers that seldom generate axis-aligned images.
